# Institute for Youth in Policy

> Youth-led nonpartisan organization forging civic innovation, policy research, and democracy strengthening through education, discourse, and youth leadership.

YIP operates multiple centers and programs including the Center for Civic Growth, PIVOT (cross-border youth hub), the Branden Center for geopolitical research, and an intensive Public Policy Fellowship. The organization combines policy research, civic education, and youth engagement to strengthen democratic participation and informed public discourse.

## Key Topics

- Policy Research
- Youth Leadership

## Core Programs & Centers

- [Home](https://yipinstitute.org): YIP homepage: youth-led org forging civic innovation, policy engagement, and democracy strengthening.
- [About](https://yipinstitute.org/about): YIP mission: nonpartisan, youth-led org strengthening discourse and civic engagement.
- [Public Policy Fellowship](https://yipinstitute.org/fellowship): YIP's intensive two-month fellowship for young leaders developing policy solutions.
- [Center for Civic Growth](https://yipinstitute.org/ccg): Center for Civic Growth: youth-led hub for policy projects and civic change initiatives.
- [PIVOT Center](https://yipinstitute.org/pivot): PIVOT Center: cross-border youth hub equipping leaders with policy research and reform skills.
- [Branden Center](https://yipinstitute.org/branden-center): Branden Center specializing in US-East Asia relations and geopolitical policy research.

## Research & Policy Analysis

- [Research](https://yipinstitute.org/research): YIP's policy research hub with briefs, journal, and nonpartisan analysis on global trends.
- [Policy Briefs](https://yipinstitute.org/policy): YIP policy briefs: nonpartisan analyses on economic, health, and international issues.
- [Articles](https://yipinstitute.org/articles): YIP articles: op-eds and in-depth policy analysis on foreign and social policy.
- [Economic Policy](https://yipinstitute.org/topic/economy): YIP economic policy briefs covering tariffs, loans, monetary policy, and Gen Z finance.

## Education & Civic Discourse

- [Education](https://yipinstitute.org/education): YIP Education branch creating civic curriculum promoting discourse and policy civics.
- [Effective Discourse](https://yipinstitute.org/effective-discourse): YIP's Discourse department fostering informed policy debates and civic participation.
- [AP Annual Conference](https://yipinstitute.org/apac): YIP's AP Annual Conference civics education initiatives and College Board partnerships.

## Fellowship & Projects

- [Fellowship Capstones](https://yipinstitute.org/capstones): YIP Fellowship capstone projects showcasing innovative policy solutions by fellows.
- [Mathematical Pathways to Responsible AI Governance](https://yipinstitute.org/capstone/pathways-to-ai-governance-innovation): Capstone on quantitative AI governance model for equity, safety, and responsible innovation.
- [Structural Solutions for an Equitable Coffee Value Chain](https://yipinstitute.org/capstone/structural-solutions-for-an-equitable-coffee-value-chain): Capstone analyzing coffee trade equity and proposing supply chain reform solutions.

## Organization & People

- [The Team](https://yipinstitute.org/team): YIP management, fellows, members, and staff directory with bios and leadership info.
- [Join](https://yipinstitute.org/join): YIP careers and opportunities: internships, fellowships, and policy positions available.
- [Contact](https://yipinstitute.org/contact): YIP contact form and San Francisco office location for inquiries and suggestions.
